body.name: Generic residual fiber algebra
body.construction: Let \(\phi_G:R_{\sigma}\to R_{\mathrm{src}}\) send each covariance coordinate to its acyclic SEM polynomial, put \(P_G=\ker\phi_G\), extend it to \(\psi_G:R_{\mathrm{inc}}=R_{\sigma}[\lambda_D]\to R_{\mathrm{src}}\) by fixing \(\lambda_D\), and put \(I_G=\ker\psi_G=(F_{ij}:i\ne j,\ i\leftrightarrow j\notin B)\). With \(R_G=R_{\sigma}/P_G\), \(K_G=\operatorname{Frac}(R_G)\), and the exact multiplicative set \(S_G=R_{\sigma}\setminus P_G\), define \(A_K=S_G^{-1}(R_{\mathrm{inc}}/I_G)\cong K_G\otimes_{R_G}(R_{\mathrm{inc}}/I_G)\). Equivalently, the covariance saturation is \(I_G:S_G^{\infty}=I_G\); no polynomial involving a directed source coordinate is inverted.
